project_name: Rhyolite Ridge Lithium-Boron Project (ioneer, formerly Global Geoscience)
selection_note: Hindsight-selected development case (not a sealed holdout). Selected because a dated on-site power-generation package award (ABB, Feb 2022) is public and the PFS (Oct 2018) already stated ~47 MW of on-site generation, giving an indicative ~3.3-year signal-to-award window (UNVERIFIED, see lead_time.note). Selected knowing the outcome.

Indicative only: printed 2018-10-25T06:15-04:00 to the target's Wayback first-seen 2022-02-11T09:10:53Z is about 1205 days; the target-end bound is an upper bound on availability (the true gap may be about a day shorter).

blockers: Target is a permanent-plant power/automation equipment award (steam turbine generator, distribution), not a temporary/rental/bridge generation procurement. Reviewer must decide if it counts.
ABB release capture was taken in Oct 2026 from the live page; the 2022 version was not captured, so exact-version equivalence is unproven (Wayback snapshot exists to diff).

ABB release does not state the award was conditional on FID; that comes from secondary trade coverage not captured here. FID had not occurred as of the repo's Oct 2026 screen, so the award may never convert to an executed supply order.
Fluor (feasibility/EPCM role) and the DFS release itself (ASX, 2020) were not captured; s4 relies on a trade-press mention of a 'recently completed' DFS.
PFS release is from Global Geoscience (pre-rename); the name change to ioneer is not evidenced in captured quotes.
reviewer: decide whether this counts as a procurement of the right kind (permanent steam turbine generator / power and automation package, not temporary or bridge generation).
